name: Brute Force and Credential Attack Response
description: Responds to brute force and credential stuffing alerts from SIEM. Checks failed login count against threshold, temporarily locks the targeted account, blocks the source IP on the firewall, enriches the IP via threat intelligence, and notifies the account owner if the attack appears targeted.

triggers.name: SIEM Alert
triggers.description: Receives failed login / brute force alert from Wazuh or Splunk

actions.name: Parse Alert
actions.description: Extract source IP, targeted username, failed login count, timestamp

actions.name: Check Threshold
actions.description: Check if failed login count exceeds policy threshold (default: 10 in 5 min)

actions.name: Enrich Source IP
actions.description: Check source IP reputation and abuse confidence score

actions.name: Lock Account
actions.description: Temporarily lock the targeted user account pending investigation

actions.name: Block Source IP
actions.description: Add source IP to perimeter firewall blocklist

actions.name: Create Ticket
actions.description: Log brute force attempt in case management

actions.name: Notify Account Owner
actions.description: Email the targeted user to inform them of the attack and account lock

parameters.name: subject
parameters.value: Your account has been temporarily locked — suspicious login attempts detected

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: We detected repeated failed login attempts on your account from $node_parse_alert.source_ip. Your account has been temporarily locked. Please contact the SOC.
